'''Gart''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] bafoon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].
==Biography==
A middle-aged, chubby, unshaved and dirty Human, he appeared in the [[city/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]], raving about the whereabouts of the [[ganjuko graveyard]] in the northern [[Ragnook Mountains]], and tales of weaalth and spiritual guidance. Although most individuals dismissed his hallucinations, he attracted the interest of [[Beldonna's League]], [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[hunting/Legends|hunters]], even a [[Bothan cult]]. Thus he got many people who were interested in talking to him, as well as enemies. 

However he attracted also the interest of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was captured by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and interrogated. Although many noticed that he had disappeared, [[Dakkar]] claimed that he was hiding in an abandoned warehouse.

In reality, after his capture, he was impersonated by ISB agent [[Cladus Glynn]] as a trap for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
